changelog:
The Vault 2.0.7

New
- Spice: every file now gets one rating, Safe, Suggestive, Explicit or Hardcore, with one-click Spice chips in the Tags filter.
- Your taste profile: For you picks, Hidden gems and a Your type recap, learned from the files you finish, edge and rate.
- Tag Hall of Fame, More like this in the viewer, and a Spice ramp slideshow that a connected device can follow.
- Hall of Fame history: step back through past days, weeks and months.
- Cards: traits on card faces, a card back with your history together, trait collections, weekly card bounties and binder sessions.
- Erika reacts to the packs you open.
- Mobile app: tabs, scroll and filters remember where you were, and Back closes sheets first.
- New optional AI models: WD EVA02 Large, NudeNet and the Spice vibe check.

Changed
- AI tagging is much faster, sees more detail and gets colours right.
- The card window is rebuilt, and the Tags filter is redesigned.
- The first video after starting the app opens faster.

Fixes
- The GPU download for AI tagging no longer fails on Windows with "No Windows wheel found".
- Going back from a gallery returns you to where you were in the list.
- One people tag and one Spice rating per file, and better Exposure on cards.
- Set avatar or banner from video opens .mov and 4K videos quickly.

Removed
- AI no longer guesses characters (its guesses were wrong on most real photos). Characters you link yourself stay.

────────────

The Vault 2.0.6

New
- Mobile app: swipe curating. Rate files with stars, swipe right for next, swipe left for not now, and double tap to favorite. Open it from the Curate card on Home.
- Mobile app: your cards now look exactly like they do on desktop, with type and rarity filters.
- Mobile app: Hall of Fame and Recap.
- Connect your phone by QR code (Settings → System), over home Wi-Fi or over Tailscale from anywhere. The Android app pairs straight from the code.
- The Android app tells you when a newer version is ready.
- File curating can focus the run on any creator of the current file.

Changed
- Gallery select mode: Esc leaves it, and the selection bar stays pinned at the top while you scroll.
